subject: prd/worker-transcript-metrics
statement: The system shall reconcile its records against an authoritative launch record produced independently of capture, and shall record any launch found in that record with neither a process record nor a capture-failure entry.
rationale: every completeness figure needs a denominator capture cannot author: a process whose capture never ran emits no event of its own, so a metric fed only by capture's own events cannot see it — the silence this contract most needs to detect *(#D-6)*
fit_criterion: seeding the checkpoint batch with a launch whose capture is suppressed entirely yields a recorded discrepancy naming that launch; the launch record's producer is the executor, not this feature
